messages:
anya: Quick sync — we need to lock the Velvet Bridge rollout lanes for Q2. Main concerns: upgrade paths for field customers, customer-managed networking modes (VPC vs on‑prem), and minimal launch gates for alpha installs. Can we do a fast decision thread?
ben: +1. What SLAs / rollback window are we committing to for the vpc lane? need clarity before we promise.
cory: for field customers, big constraints: strict IP whitelisting, no outbound to internet in some pockets, and older k8s versions in a couple accounts. any plan for an offline agent or staging patch?
dana: security flags — KMS integration + HSM support must be explicit for enterprise alpha. also audit-log format and retention default. will need a checklist for compliance review.
eva: propose phased rollout: 1) vpc-managed (customers with cloud VPC + peering), 2) onprem light (online agent + NAT), 3) air-gapped/onbox. rollout should use pinned model versions and canary routes.
infra-bot: staging clusters: 3/3 healthy, test-image:v2 queued on canary pool. current throughput baseline: 95th latency 140ms on n1-standard profile.
anya: ok — propose we formalize three upgrade lanes and acceptance criteria now:
```
Lanes: vpc-managed | onprem-online | airgapped
Acceptance (alpha):
- successful 24h stress run on staging (latency + mem)
- documented handshake for customer NetOps (IP list, ports, egress rules)
- KMS key provisioning workflow documented
- offline-agent install + rollback verified (for airgapped)
```
ben: that looks fair. I think vpc-managed should be our primary Q2 ship lane. smaller blast radius and easier rollback.
eva: agree. also add an upgrade rehearsal step: run the upgrade workflow against a copy of customer config and validate token/key rotations. example command we can script: `./velvet-upgrade --dry-run --rehearse --config sample.yaml`
cory: I can own the ops checklist and the IP/port matrix. will post a draft checklist doc later today.
dana: I'll draft KMS/HSM acceptance and compliance checklist. one ask: add logging toggle for reduced retention in EU customers (GDPR helm chart flag).
anya: action items: cory = ops checklist, dana = security checklist, eva = rollout orchestration + canary policy, ben = SLA/rollback wording, infra-bot/infra = run 24h stress during Thurs window. Please react with :thumbsup: if you agree to lane prioritization (vpc-managed first). If no objections by EOD, we'll lock the lanes and start scheduling rehearsals.
eva: :thumbsup:
cory: :thumbsup:
dana: :thumbsup:
ben: will post SLA draft by 1600 PT
anya: cheers — planning doc link to follow in a new thread. keep comments here for anything blocking the alpha criteria.
infra-bot: scheduled stress run: Thu 03:00-27:00 UTC, cluster: staging-velvet-canary. test-id: sb-velvet-004
anya: noted. thanks all — looping in solutions eng for field comms after checklists are posted.
